title: Web application architecture
goal: Show a scalable web application request path and asynchronous worker tier.

rubric.must: Browser Client, CDN/WAF, and Load Balancer visibly form the entry request path.
The load balancer visibly fans out to two separate app-server blocks.
Both app servers visibly connect to the cache and database.
A job queue visibly feeds two workers, both of which connect to the database.
HTTPS, SQL, cache, and job-message labels are visible on relevant paths.

ideal.notes: Refreshed against the September 15 exemplar: role fills, ink signal lines, 4 px block corners and restrained typography. Each target retains its own functional topology; generic blocks are not assigned inferred hardware roles.
